context: Tests whether the agent respects spec freeze and task boundaries during implementation phase

checklist.name: does-not-modify-spec
checklist.description: Agent explicitly states it will NOT modify spec.md because it is frozen (status: Implementing)

checklist.name: notes-in-progress-log
checklist.description: Agent says it will note the new requirement in the progress log for a follow-up spec

checklist.name: does-not-expand-task-scope
checklist.description: Agent states it will NOT add full-text indexing to the current task or any existing task

checklist.name: explains-why-to-user
checklist.description: Agent explains to the user WHY it cannot add this now (spec is frozen, scope creep, follow-up spec needed)

checklist.name: suggests-follow-up-spec
checklist.description: Agent suggests creating a separate follow-up spec for the full-text indexing feature

checklist.name: continues-current-task
checklist.description: Agent indicates it will continue with the current task as scoped, not pause indefinitely
